title: Use relative response rather than integrating a uniform absolute error forever
statement: The supplied completed P1final reports a relative-dissipation compressed evolution bound withr=M/kappa<1and uniform errorr/(2sqrt(1-r)); a separate resolvent comparison bounds an equilibrium mode integrated relaxation between1/omega_qand1/[(1-r)omega_q]. Required selective strengthkappa>=M(1+epsilon)/epsilonis independent of system size/wavelength, while the actual relaxation can still grow asN^2. Visible final/activity only: original archive, four central proof/review files and code did not transfer. Reported completed independent reviews at saved versions are preserved without fabricated source-bound review overlays. Fixed projection/common equilibrium, warranted relative energy/local mobility, selective independent phase operation and retained record/initial-law contracts are required. Two actual successive flips/local acquisition need rate ceilings, bath spacing and confidence costs. FiniteTVterminal preparation does NOT justify an infinite-time integral. No apparatus, measured speedup, full path-law/accelerated mixing or settled priority.
